<parameter name="MPC_VC_MODE" default="0" type="INT32">
      <short_desc>Velocity controller request</short_desc>
      <long_desc>Accepts PID/AXES=0 or SITL ESTA/AXES=1..7 with valid independent gains. AX01 Y/XZ/YZ require DIV1. MODE2 remains reserved and rejected. R03 gate D admits MODE3 regularized explicit STA on NED X, Z, XY or XYZ (AXES=1/4/3/7), in SITL with DIV1 and valid gains/epsilon. Other MODE3 masks remain rejected. RI05 gate A admits MODE4 compensated regularized implicit STA on NED X, Z or XY (AXES=1/4/3), in SITL with DIV1 and valid gains/epsilon. Other axes remain PID. All other MODE4 masks remain rejected. The configuration retains all 15 values. Armed requests are pending until disarm; requesting the effective configuration cancels pending changes. Original PID gain updates are unaffected.</long_desc>
      <min>0</min>
      <max>4</max>
      <values>
        <value code="0">PID</value>
        <value code="1">ESTA selected NED axes (SITL only)</value>
        <value code="2">Reserved (unavailable)</value>
        <value code="3">Regularized explicit STA X, Z, XY or XYZ (SITL only, R03 gate D)</value>
        <value code="4">Regularized implicit STA X/Z/XY (SITL only, RI05 A)</value>
      </values>
    </parameter>
